$doc: User overlay for Claude Fusion Drive — deep-merged over config/fusion-drive.default.json by claude_fusion_drive.config.load_config().

Panel/judge/fuser composition replicates the DRACO 71.6 fusion result: independent panel -> compact JSON judge -> generative fuser. No majority vote, no averaging; lone-correct minority findings must survive.

Provider pins use seat.provider_routing, emitted verbatim as OpenRouter's `provider` field. All four pins were verified live against /api/v1/models/<model>/endpoints on 2026-08-07 — every pinned provider actually serves its model.

Output-token tiers follow the DRACO scripts: panel tool-loop turns 8000, panel synthesis 12000, judge 3000, fuser 8000. Judge and fuser are raised here (see $token_notes) because this panel feeds them more inputs than DRACO's did.

draco-panel-sol-codex.persona: Independent systems and implementation panelist; trace constraints, edge cases, and failure modes to concrete evidence.

draco-panel-grok45.persona: Independent evidence-first researcher; surface falsifiable minority findings rather than converging on the obvious reading.

draco-panel-fable5.persona: Independent constraint auditor; verify each claim against the stated requirements and name what the other readings would miss.

draco-panel-opus5.persona: Independent constraint auditor (fallback seat for the fable-5 chair); verify claims against requirements and preserve dissent.

draco-panel-deepseek-v4-pro.persona: Independent mechanical re-verifier; recompute the load-bearing steps and report where the derivation actually breaks.

draco-judge-gemini.persona: Comparative judge over anonymised panel reports. Emit compact JSON only with EXACTLY these keys and no others: consensus, contradictions, partial_coverage, unique_insights, minority_findings, blind_spots, final_guidance. Each value is an array of strings. Do NOT include verification_priorities or any other key. Never write the final answer.

draco-fuser-minimax.persona: Generative synthesiser. Write one fresh standalone answer from the original task, the raw panel reports, and the judge's diagnosis. Do not vote, average, or splice; preserve supported minority findings and resolve contradictions on evidence.

t-light-qwen.persona: Independent implementer. Solve directly; concrete commands/edits and why they work.

t-light-dsflash.persona: Independent constraint auditor. Attack the obvious solution; separate what the task requires from what it appears to require.

t-light-luna.persona: Independent mechanical re-verifier. Recompute load-bearing steps; state exactly where a proposed fix fails.

t-light-judge.persona: Comparative judge over anonymised panel reports. Emit compact JSON only with EXACTLY these keys and no others: consensus, contradictions, partial_coverage, unique_insights, minority_findings, blind_spots, final_guidance. Each value is an array of strings. Never write the final answer.

t-light-fuser.persona: Generative synthesiser. One fresh standalone answer from task, raw panel reports, and judge diagnosis. No voting, averaging, or splicing; preserve supported minority findings; resolve contradictions on evidence.

t-med-qwen.persona: Independent implementer. Solve directly; concrete commands/edits and why they work.

t-med-nemotron.persona: Independent constraint auditor. Attack the obvious solution; separate what the task requires from what it appears to require.

t-med-dspro.persona: Independent mechanical re-verifier. Recompute load-bearing steps; state exactly where a proposed fix fails.

t-med-luna.persona: Independent planner. Produce a stepwise executable plan with risks, checkpoints, and rollback points.

draco-panel-sol-api.persona: Independent systems and implementation panelist; trace constraints, edge cases, and failure modes to concrete evidence.

$token_notes: Verified provider output caps (live, 2026-08-07): grok-4.5@xAI unset/ctx 500k · gemini-3.1-pro@google-vertex 65536 · minimax-m3@Venice 65536 · deepseek-v4-pro@BaseTen 262144 · fable-5/opus-5@Anthropic 128000. Every value below sits well inside its cap.
Panel 12000 = DRACO's --synthesis-max-tokens (its --max-tokens 8000 governs intermediate tool-loop turns, which these seats do not run: tool_policy is none).

Judge raised 3000 -> 8000. DRACO's judge emitted 6 keys; this judge's schema requires 8 (adds minority_findings and verification_priorities) and reads 4 panel reports. 3000 would truncate the JSON, and a truncated judge silently degrades the fuser.

Fuser raised 8000 -> 16000. DRACO fused 5 short-form benchmark answers; this fuser consumes 4x12000-token panel reports plus a richer judge blob, and its output is the only thing the caller sees. Truncating the fuser is the one failure that loses the whole run.
These are ceilings, not targets — seats bill on tokens actually produced, so the raises cost nothing on short tasks.
$wiring_notes: gpt-5.6-sol runs on the codex plugin (provider codex_oauth, transport codex_cli_oauth, ChatGPT subscription auth) rather than OpenRouter, so the panel keeps a non-metered seat. Note codex_oauth has max_concurrency 1, so that seat serialises against other codex work.
grok-4.5 is reached through OpenRouter pinned to the xai upstream (BYOK), not the direct xai_api provider — one bill, one set of logs.

The drive seat schema has no per-seat fallback field (_legacy_seat hardcodes fallback_seats: []), so the opus-5 xhigh fallback for the fable-5 chair is wired as optional_panel rather than a true automatic failover. With min_live_seats 3 the gate still proceeds if the fable-5 chair dies; promoting opus-5 is currently a manual swap.

provider_routing support required two edits to the plugin: schemas/fusion-drive.schema.json gained the property (the seat object is additionalProperties:false), and claude_fusion_drive/engine.py::_legacy_seat now passes it through. relentless_inception/providers.py already merged seat.provider_routing into the request's provider field and needed no change.
$draco_pass_2026_08_07: Authoritative DRACO hyperparameters (verified against Lore-Hex/TrustedRouter-Fusion-Draco source, not the summary):

PANEL (draco_agentic_solo.py): max_tool_calls 16, tool-loop max_tokens 8000, synthesis_max_tokens 12000, temperature 0.2 (skipped for gpt-5.5*), reasoning_effort default None, workers 2, timeout 600s, length-retry ladder (8000,12000) +(16000,32000) for gpt-5.5.

JUDGE (draco_client_fusion.py): gemini-3.1-pro-preview, max_tokens 3000, response_format json_object. CORRECTIONS to the circulated summary: the fusion judge body sets NO temperature (0.0 was the TR grading judge) and NO reasoning_effort ('high' is fusion_live.py's GRADING default).

FUSER: minimax-m3, max_tokens 8000, temperature 0.2 explicit, no response_format; messages are TWO user turns (problem, then FINAL_INSTRUCTION+evidence+judge) with no system prompt; 5 attempts (first pinned, then unpinned) with 1.5s*n backoff and a >=50-char floor; cross-model fallback only if explicitly configured.
PROVIDER PIN: {'only':[p],'allow_fallbacks':false} — matches this config's provider_routing.

DELIBERATE divergences here: seats run reasoning high/xhigh per operator instruction (temperature is then provider-managed; the drive seat schema has no temperature field), ceilings raised because reasoning tokens bill as output, and panel identity is anonymised to judge/fuser (DRACO leaks model= names in panel evidence).
$vertex_billing_note: Judge pin is order[google-vertex, google-ai-studio]: the BYOK Vertex key's GCP project (formidable-bus-484218-v3) returned 403 BILLING_DISABLED on 2026-08-07. Enable billing on that project and Vertex becomes primary again automatically; AI Studio pin verified 200 the same day.
$tiers: TIER LADDER — switch per call (fuse profile_name=..., seat_run profile=...) or persistently (config_set active_profile). No restart needed.
light  = qwen3.7-flash + deepseek-v4-flash + luna-pro panel · qwen judge · luna fuser · NO gates (~cents).
medium = qwen + nemotron-super + deepseek-pro + luna (all ~1M ctx) · gemini judge · minimax fuser · NO gates.

heavy  = draco frontier mix (sol via CODEX SUBSCRIPTION + grok/fable/deepseek API) · gemini judge · minimax fuser · grok gates ON. heavy-nogate drops the gate; heavy-api swaps the sol chair to metered OpenRouter (billing switch, same hyperparameters).
ultra  = heavy + opus-5 xhigh promoted to a 5th live seat, min_live 4, gates ON, $25 cap.

INVARIANT across every tier: panel out=32000, judge out=16000, fuser out=32000, timeout 1200s, tool_policy none, reasoning high (opus seat xhigh; grok capped at high upstream). Changing a seat's model NEVER changes these knobs — swap the model string or seat only.
Judge always routes order[google-vertex, google-ai-studio] (Vertex primary once GCP billing is enabled).
